patterns.name: AddIAddConstant
patterns.description: Combine nested addi with a constant on each level: addi(addi(x,c0),c1) -> addi(x,c0+c1).
patterns.conditions: Both matched constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; APInt arithmetic is at the result width; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: AddISubConstantRHS
patterns.description: Fold addi(subi(x,c0),c1) into addi(x,c1-c0).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags from inner subi and outer addi are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: AddISubConstantLHS
patterns.description: Fold addi(subi(c0,x),c1) into subi(c0+c1,x).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags from inner subi and outer addi are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: AddIMulNegativeOneRhs
patterns.description: Rewrite addi(x,muli(y,-1)) to subi(x,y).
patterns.conditions: Multiplier constant must be scalar/splat integer all-ones (-1); replacement uses default/no-overflow flags (TODO in source notes lost overflow flags).

patterns.name: AddIMulNegativeOneLhs
patterns.description: Rewrite addi(muli(x,-1),y) to subi(y,x).
patterns.conditions: Multiplier constant must be scalar/splat integer all-ones (-1); replacement uses default/no-overflow flags (TODO in source notes lost overflow flags).

patterns.name: MulIMulIConstant
patterns.description: Combine muli(muli(x,c0),c1) into muli(x,c0*c1).
patterns.conditions: Both constants’ integer attribute types must equal the outer result type; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: AddUIExtendedToAddI
patterns.description: Replace addui_extended(x,y) by addi(x,y) and x for the unused overflow result.
patterns.conditions: Second/overflow result must have no uses; any replacement value is permitted for that unused result; addi receives default/no-overflow flags.

patterns.name: SubUIExtendedToSubI
patterns.description: Replace subui_extended(x,y) by subi(x,y) and x for the unused borrow result.
patterns.conditions: Second/borrow result must have no uses; any replacement value is permitted for that unused result; subi receives default/no-overflow flags.

patterns.name: SubIRHSAddConstant
patterns.description: Fold subi(addi(x,c0),c1) into addi(x,c0-c1).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; replacement uses default/no-overflow flags (TODO in source notes lost overflow flags).

patterns.name: SubILHSAddConstant
patterns.description: Fold subi(c1,addi(x,c0)) into subi(c1-c0,x).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags from inner addi and outer subi are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: SubIRHSSubConstantRHS
patterns.description: Fold subi(subi(x,c0),c1) into subi(x,c0+c1).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: SubIRHSSubConstantLHS
patterns.description: Fold subi(subi(c0,x),c1) into subi(c0-c1,x).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: SubILHSSubConstantRHS
patterns.description: Fold subi(c1,subi(x,c0)) into subi(c0+c1,x).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: SubILHSSubConstantLHS
patterns.description: Fold subi(c1,subi(c0,x)) into addi(x,c1-c0).
patterns.conditions: Both constants are ConstantLike integer attributes; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: SubISubILHSRHSLHS
patterns.description: Rewrite subi(subi(x,y),x) to subi(0,y).
patterns.conditions: Repeated x must be the same SSA value; zero constant materialization requires scalar or statically shaped type; overflow flags are merged by bitwise intersection.

patterns.name: MulSIExtendedToMulI
patterns.description: Replace mulsi_extended(x,y) by muli(x,y) and x for unused high result.
patterns.conditions: High result must have no uses; any replacement value is permitted for that unused result; muli receives default/no-overflow flags.

patterns.name: MulSIExtendedRHSOne
patterns.description: Rewrite mulsi_extended(x,1) to x and extsi(cmpi slt,x,0).
patterns.conditions: RHS must be scalar/splat integer value strictly positive and equal to 1; zero constant for cmpi must be materializable for x type.

patterns.name: MulUIExtendedToMulI
patterns.description: Replace mului_extended(x,y) by muli(x,y) and x for unused high result.
patterns.conditions: High result must have no uses; any replacement value is permitted for that unused result; muli receives default/no-overflow flags.

patterns.name: XOrIXOrIConstant
patterns.description: Combine xori(xori(x,c0),c1) into xori(x,c0 xor c1).
patterns.conditions: Both integer attribute types must equal the outer result type.

patterns.name: XOrINotCmpI
patterns.description: Rewrite xori(cmpi(pred,a,b),true) to cmpi(invert(pred),a,b).
patterns.conditions: The xor constant must be scalar i1 constant 1; all CmpI predicates have a defined inverse.

patterns.name: XOrIOfExtUI
patterns.description: Push xori through two extui operations: xori(extui(x),extui(y)) -> extui(xori(x,y)).
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match; resulting nneg is preserved only when both input extui ops carry nneg.

patterns.name: XOrIOfExtSI
patterns.description: Push xori through two extsi operations.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match.

patterns.name: CmpIExtSI
patterns.description: Push equality/inequality cmpi through matching extsi operands.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match; predicate must be eq or ne.

patterns.name: CmpIExtUI
patterns.description: Push equality/inequality cmpi through matching extui operands.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match; predicate must be eq or ne; nneg flags do not constrain match.

patterns.name: SelectNotCond
patterns.description: Rewrite select(xori(pred,-1),a,b) to select(pred,b,a).
patterns.conditions: Xor constant must be scalar/splat all-ones (-1).

patterns.name: RedundantSelectTrue
patterns.description: Simplify select(pred,select(pred,a,b),c) to select(pred,a,c).
patterns.conditions: Inner and outer conditions must be the same SSA value.

patterns.name: RedundantSelectFalse
patterns.description: Simplify select(pred,a,select(pred,b,c)) to select(pred,a,c).
patterns.conditions: Inner and outer conditions must be the same SSA value.

patterns.name: SelectI1ToNot
patterns.description: Rewrite select(pred,false,true) to xori(pred,true).
patterns.conditions: True/false arms must be scalar i1 constants 0 and 1, respectively.

patterns.name: SelectCmpISltToMinSI
patterns.description: Canonicalize select(cmpi slt,a,b) to arith.minsi(a,b) when select arms are a,b arms.
patterns.conditions: Predicate is exactly slt; compare operands and the corresponding select arms are SSA-identical as required by the base pattern.

patterns.name: SelectCmpISleToMinSI

patterns.name: IndexCastOfExtSI
patterns.description: Remove redundant sign extension under index_cast.
patterns.conditions: No additional pattern constraint; replacement must satisfy op verifier/type rules.

patterns.name: IndexCastUIOfExtUI
patterns.description: Remove nested zero extension under index_castui.
patterns.conditions: No additional pattern constraint; outer index_castui retains inner extui nneg attribute.

patterns.name: BitcastOfBitcast
patterns.description: Collapse nested bitcast.
patterns.conditions: Types must satisfy bitcast verifier constraints.

patterns.name: ExtSIOfExtUI
patterns.description: Replace extsi(extui(x)) with extui(x).
patterns.conditions: No additional pattern constraint; retain extui nneg attribute.

patterns.name: AndIAndIConstant
patterns.description: Combine andi(andi(x,c0),c1) into andi(x,c0 & c1).
patterns.conditions: Both integer attribute types must equal the outer result type.

patterns.name: AndOfExtUI
patterns.description: Push andi through two extui operations.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match; resulting nneg is true if either input extui has nneg.

patterns.name: AndOfExtSI
patterns.description: Push andi through two extsi operations.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match.

patterns.name: OrIOrIConstant
patterns.description: Combine ori(ori(x,c0),c1) into ori(x,c0 | c1).
patterns.conditions: Both integer attribute types must equal the outer result type.

patterns.name: OrOfExtUI
patterns.description: Push ori through two extui operations.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match; resulting nneg is preserved only when both input extui ops carry nneg.

patterns.name: OrOfExtSI
patterns.description: Push ori through two extsi operations.
patterns.conditions: Narrow source types must match.

patterns.name: TruncIExtSIToExtSI
patterns.description: Cancel truncation of an extension when the trunc result remains wider than the original source.
patterns.conditions: Extension result width > trunc result width > source width; preserve semantics at widths above zero.

patterns.name: TruncIExtUIToExtUI
patterns.description: Cancel truncation of an extension when the trunc result remains wider than the original source.
patterns.conditions: Extension result width > trunc result width > source width; preserve extui nneg.

patterns.name: TruncIShrSIToTrunciShrUI
patterns.description: Rewrite trunci(shrsi(x,c)) to trunci(shrui(x,c)) when truncation removes exactly the shifted-off sign bits.
patterns.conditions: Shift amount must be scalar/splat integer and equal input width minus trunc result width; the typed shift attribute is retained; exact flag and trunc overflow attribute are preserved.

patterns.name: TruncFSIToFPToSIToFP
patterns.description: Cancel truncf(sitofp(x)) when truncf uses default rounding mode.
patterns.conditions: Outer truncf rounding mode must be absent/null; floating-point fast-math flags are not checked by this pattern.

patterns.name: TruncFUIToFPToUIToFP
patterns.description: Cancel truncf(uitofp(x)) when truncf uses default rounding mode.
patterns.conditions: Outer truncf rounding mode must be absent/null; preserve uitofp nneg; floating-point fast-math flags are not checked by this pattern.

patterns.name: SIToFPOfExtSI
patterns.description: Remove redundant sign extension before sitofp.
patterns.conditions: No additional pattern constraint.

patterns.name: SIToFPOfExtUI
patterns.description: Rewrite sitofp(extui(x)) as uitofp(x).
patterns.conditions: Preserve extui nneg on replacement uitofp.

patterns.name: UIToFPOfExtUI
patterns.description: Remove redundant extui before uitofp.
patterns.conditions: Preserve extui nneg on replacement uitofp.

patterns.name: AddFOfNegFLhs
patterns.description: Rewrite addf(negf(x),y) to subf(y,x).
patterns.conditions: Negf fast-math flags are ignored; addf fast-math flags and rounding mode are preserved on subf. Source comment claims bit identity for any rounding mode.

patterns.name: AddFOfNegFRhs
patterns.description: Rewrite addf(x,negf(y)) to subf(x,y).
patterns.conditions: Negf fast-math flags are ignored; addf fast-math flags and rounding mode are preserved on subf. Source comment claims bit identity for any rounding mode.

patterns.name: SubFOfNegZero
patterns.description: Rewrite subf(-0.0,x) to negf(x).
patterns.conditions: LHS must match scalar/splat negative-zero float; subf rounding mode must be absent/null (source TODO says custom rounding mode safety unverified); subf fast-math flags are transferred.

patterns.name: MulFOfNegF
patterns.description: Rewrite mulf(negf(x),negf(y)) to mulf(x,y).
patterns.conditions: x and y types must match; outer mulf rounding mode must be absent/null; preserve outer fast-math flags. Source TODO says custom-rounding safety unverified.

patterns.name: DivFOfNegF
patterns.description: Rewrite divf(negf(x),negf(y)) to divf(x,y).
patterns.conditions: x and y types must match; outer divf rounding mode must be absent/null; preserve outer fast-math flags. Source TODO says custom-rounding safety unverified.
